title: DSC-anchored CALPHAD surrogate pipeline for Ni-base superalloys
description: Open workflow linking pycalphad and the open MatCalc Ni database to Gaussian-process, polynomial-chaos and neural-network surrogates for DSC-relevant thermal signatures, with literature DSC anchoring and uncertainty-aware heat-treatment-window screening.
